answer: Arrival-shape freeze gate records each agent's inter-transaction gaps in a 300-second window as its zephyr. Two agents with a Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance under 0.08 trigger juniper, locking the newer ID out for 24 hours. Each extra colluder adds 24 hours, so an atlas of 50 fakes costs 1,200 lost agent-hours.
